title: Battle Through the Heavens: Battle of the Two Emperors Indonesia, English Sub
description:
Inggris

The decisive battle between Xiao Yan (who successfully rose and broke through to the Dou Di realm as the Flame Emperor) versus Hun Tiandi (the leader of the Hun Clan, who also reached the Dou Di level using the imperial pill and the blood of the ancient clans).

Indonesia

Pertarungan penentu antara Xiao Yan (yang berhasil bangkit dan menerobos ke ranah Dou Di sebagai Flame Emperor) melawan Hun Tiandi (pemimpin Klan Hun yang juga mencapai tingkat Dou Di menggunakan pil kekaisaran dan darah klan kuno).
